Hi all —

Thanks for the context. TL;DR: we will issue a formal credit memo (CM) that references the customer PO and contains a CM number. A few internal notes and requests so accounting can book the credit cleanly: 

- We need the PO number in writing (Hilary already provided ORBIT-8821, good). Please confirm the bill-to legal entity for Orbit (full legal name and billing address) so the CM matches SAP/Vendor records.
- For GL mapping, promo credits hit contra-revenue account 6100-PR (promo credit memos) by default. If Orbit requires a different mapping for audit reasons, we need that now.
- Credit memos will be dated the day they are issued; if you need a backdated effective date, provide justification for internal controls.
- Once CM is issued, Neha will attach the CM PDF to the invoice in our billing portal — you will see CM#: CM-2026-0459 (example format).

Neha / Kimberly: what supporting docs do you want uploaded to the customer record? We can include the SOW and the promo terms.
